data.narrative:
Aeon Industrial is a Seed-stage defense & security company founded by Naweed Tahmas and Joe Cieslik that has raised $18.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $18.6M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $46M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in the cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $40M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $373M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound conservatively; peer median establishes the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the appropriate peer weighting given the 32x spread between minimum and maximum comps, and whether Aeon's specific technology differentiation and market positioning justify positioning within this wide range.
